semantics.clock: Sample serial input and update state on each positive clock edge, as specified.
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset returns to idle and clears done at the rising edge; no asynchronous response.
semantics.framing: Idle high; sampled low starts a frame. Consume exactly the next eight samples as data, regardless of value. The following sample is the stop bit.
semantics.completion: A high valid stop sample asserts done after that edge for one clock cycle. The next sample may start another frame immediately if low.
semantics.bad_stop: A low expected stop sample produces no done. Ignore all subsequent lows until a high sample restores idle; that recovery high does not complete the rejected frame.
semantics.initialization: No power-up value is specified; behavior is verified after a synchronous reset. No initial block in DUT.
semantics.data_order: Data arrives least significant bit first; no data output or data storage is required.

numeric.counter: Three bits represent data positions zero through seven.

verification.oracle: Independent procedural frame parser derived from original start/eight-data/stop requirements.
verification.sampling: Drive inputs on falling edges, compare done after rising-edge NBA settlement, and verify it holds between edges.
cases: synchronous reset including mid-frame and done
bad stop and prolonged low recovery
verification.termination: Fatal on mismatch or bounded timeout; PASS only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities: The prose does not explicitly specify done pulse width. Interpret identification of each received byte as a one-cycle pulse starting immediately after the valid stop-bit sampling edge.
Power-up state is unspecified; do not assume defined outputs before reset.
